summary: Content signing is off by default; enable with hub_collection_signing=true and hub_container_signing=true plus GPG key paths (hub_*_signing_key) and passphrases (hub_*_signing_pass); only GPG keys are supported.
questions: How do I enable collection signing in automation hub?
What key types does hub content signing support?

answer_card.title: Enable content signing
answer_card.answer_md:
```ini
hub_collection_signing=true
hub_collection_signing_key=<path_to_collection_gpg_key>
hub_collection_signing_pass=<passphrase>   # if protected
hub_container_signing=true
hub_container_signing_key=<path_to_container_gpg_key>
hub_container_signing_pass=<passphrase>
```
GPG keys only; create them before installing.
